title: VEKA - Wikipedia
content: # VEKA. **VEKA AG** is a German extruder of uPVC profiles for use in windows, doors, roller shutters and sliding doors headquartered in Sendenhorst, Germany. Founded in 1967 as a manufacturer of shutters, it currently operates its own extrusion facilities in twelve countries. VEKA was founded in Sendenhorst, West Germany under the name Vekaplast in 1967 and initially produced only roller shutters. Due to growing demand, the company acquired his 115,000 square meters of land on the industrial site in Sendenhorst and built a new extrusion plant there after surpassing his 15,000 square meters of leased plant. In 1983, VEKA decided to increase its exports to foreign markets due to economic stagnation in West Germany, establishing subsidiaries in Spain, France, and the United States within a year. In 1993, VEKA opened a 120,000 square foot recycling center and established a subsidiary, VEKA West, Inc., in Reno, Nevada to serve the western United States. VEKA Holdings Inc. was also established to manage his VEKA operations in the United States.

title: About VEKA
content: A family business with fantastic employees. From small business to global market leader in 50 years. Since it was established in 1969, VEKA has evolved from a small local company into a global market leader for PVC profile systems for windows and doors. Today, the family business headquartered in the Westphalia region of Germany is active on four continents: all over the world, quality-conscious consumers are choosing architectural elements made from VEKA quality profiles. From the start, VEKA AG focused on products of the highest quality, and it has steadily expanded its competitive position over the years. The company pursues an investment and expansion policy geared towards sustainable growth – because it continues to cultivate the ethos of a family firm, focusing on customers while also taking responsibility for people and the environment. They know our customers’ requirements and have a great deal of experience with our products. ### We are a family business, so sustainability is in our DNA.

title: Who we are
content: VEKA, the world's leading manufacturer of PVC profiles, is recognized in more than 80 countries for its commitment to the environment and the exceptional quality of its PVC profile systems for doors, windows and shutters. Founded in 1969 by Heinrich Laumann, in the city of Sendenhorst, Germany, VEKA combines tradition and modernity in research and development to create product lines differentiated in contemporary design, efficiency and sustainability. As a pioneer, it conquered the market and drove the business that today makes VEKA the largest extruder of PVC profiles for doors and windows in the world. Quality, precision, technology and respect for the environment are values engraved in VEKA's DNA since its foundation. And, in the manufacturing process, it has always adopted strict quality criteria, according to European standards and the performance parameters required in the countries where it operates. Windows with VEKA PVC profiles are environmentally friendly and contribute to the conservation of natural resources thanks to different factors: High level of utilization and harmlessness in the extraction of raw materials.

title: Veka Customer Reference Story - Ascom
content: # A communication solution with multiple benefits at Veka. Founded in 1969 and based in Sendenhorst, Germany, VEKA AG has grown from a regional small business into a world-leading manufacturer of plastic panels as well as plastic profiles for windows, doors, and roller shutters. To ensure that the communication required for this is free of interference, employees at the headquarters in Sendenhorst used a wireless VoWLAN communication solution. In addition, existing infrastructure was to be used as much as possible. ## The Ascom solution. The Ascom IP-DECT system was used throughout the plant. Due to its interoperability with the existing Soft PBX, Cisco UCM Release 10.1\*, part of the infrastructure already in place could be covered by the Ascom IP-DECT solution. In the medium term, the plan is to replace the old alarm and messaging infrastructure with Ascom's communication platform.
